# Support

Start with the [documentation map](../docs/README.md), [getting started](../docs/guide/getting-started.md)
and [configuration guide](../docs/guide/configuration.md). The README and guides have Spanish
editions; the thesis dossier is in Spanish.

Use the [issue chooser](https://github.com/Yosoyepa/Ommatix/issues/new/choose):

- **Bug report:** reproducible behaviour, preferably on the simulated desktop.
- **Feature request:** the problem, proposed behaviour and relevant thesis requirement.
- **Documentation or thesis:** unclear setup, a documentation question, a broken link or a
  dossier discrepancy; English and Spanish are welcome.

Include a commit and enough sanitised context to reproduce the problem. Never attach a real
screen capture, personal screen text, credentials or model weights. Security reports use
[the private vulnerability form](SECURITY.md), never a public issue.

Ommatix is a research prototype with no production support or service-level commitment.
Live input is supported only in the agreed Windows 11 x64 profile, with the operator's
explicit policy; other platforms do not have supported live input. The default simulation
is the place to start. See [project status](../README.md#project-status) for current evidence
and [operator control](../docs/guide/live-input.md) before considering live input.
